text: The total drops 10% to $45.00 right away, with no refresh
trigger: Apply the discount code SAVE10 on the cart
setup: a new shopper's cart: the tote and the mug, $50.00 in total
expected: The order total changes from $50.00 to $45.00 within 1 s of applying SAVE10, without reloading the page, and still shows $45.00 after a reload
sourceQuote: On the cart, when I apply SAVE10 the total should drop 10% right away, no refresh.
